title: Introduce session-profiles, stream-demux operator, and hedged-retry simplifier across SDKs
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds session-profiles and a stream demux operator to unify multiplexed stream handling; introduces a simplified hedged-retry preset and bumps SDK versions (python v1.28.4, typescript v1.27.0, go v1.9.2).
description: Motivation: engineers building multiplexed streaming features and long-lived session flows were repeatedly re-implementing small pieces (per-call heartbeat timing, credential refresh windows, demultiplexing logical streams on a single connection, and ad-hoc hedged retries). This PR introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) session-profiles: a lightweight, declarative profile for per-client session tuning (auth refresh window, heartbeat cadence, prefetch hints) surfaced in Python/TS/Go SDKs; 2) stream-demux operator: a transport-agnostic operator that lets the client demultiplex multiple logical streams over one websocket/HTTP2 stream while preserving typed cursor semantics; 3) hedged-retry-simplifier: a pragmatic preset that replaces the previous complex hedging knobs with a small, well-documented policy that matches common production patterns. Implementation notes: session-profiles are implemented as a tiny JSON schema plus SDK-friendly builders; profile resolution is performed client-side with explicit override precedence (env -> constructor arg -> Linear-linked default); stream-demux is implemented as a composable operator layer that plugs into existing PullStream/AsyncGenerator surfaces (no runtime dependency changes); hedged-retry-simplifier provides a default policy and a small, documented API for advanced customizations. Cross-SDK changes: python: new session_profiles module and convenience factory, stream demux context manager, tests and examples, bumped to v1.28.4; typescript: new SessionProfile builder, demux operator exported from streaming package, and public types, bumped to v1.27.0; go: SessionProfile struct and StreamDemux helper with minimal GC allocations, bumped to v1.9.2. Backwards compatibility: defaults are no-op for users who don't opt into session-profiles or demux; hedged-retry-simplifier replaces the default hedged behavior but preserves surface; migration notes added to SDK changelogs. Testing: unit tests for profile resolution matrix, integration tests that exercise demux over ws and http2, fuzzed retry policy validator, and cross-sdk e2e that verifies credential refresh and stream reconnection across simulated auth flaps. Benchmarks: microbenchmarks show demux adds ~1.5ms median overhead to the happy-path per multiplexed frame but reduces connection counts by ~70% in the multiplexed scenario; hedged-retry-simplifier reduced spurious duplicate hedged requests by 30% in synthetic tail-latency tests. Rollout: feature flags enabled, staged rollout to internal Dedicated customers for two weeks, then full platform merge. Related work: builds on ENG-2979 (stream checkpoints) and ENG-3120 (credential lease), references SUP-7012 for an incident that triggered this effort. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-3245; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] changelog entries; [x] SDK version bumps; [x] docs PR in redwood-docs queued.
